title: Neural topology optimization of ship structures under propulsion machinery vibrations
abstract: arXiv:2609.38089v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ship structural vibrations contribute to noise, fatigue, and equipment damage, while dynamic-compliance topology optimization can produce pathological designs near resonance. This study extends neural-reparameterized topology optimization using a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KATO) to forced-vibration design with active input power (AIP) as the objective. Applications include a 100 Hz engine-supporting deck panel and an 18 Hz thruster foundation frame. Helmholtz PDE filtering and Heaviside projection control feature sizes and manufacturing tolerance. Across both deck families, all eight optimized layouts reduce AIP relative to size-optimized references and, after finite-depth extrusion, also achieve lower static compliance. For unrestricted, manufacturing-aware, and stress-aware frame variants, KATO matches GCMMA in AIP within 0.5 dB while yielding 22-36x lower static compliance after matched-volume binary re-analysis. translated_title: 推进机械振动作用下船舶结构的神经网络拓扑优化
translated_abstract: 船舶结构振动会导致噪声、疲劳和设备损坏，而动态柔度拓扑优化在共振频率附近可能产生病态设计。本研究将基于卷积Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KATO）的神经网络重参数化拓扑优化方法扩展到以主动输入功率（AIP）为目标的受迫振动设计。应用案例包括100 Hz的发动机支撑甲板板架和18 Hz的推进器基座框架。研究采用Helmholtz偏微分方程滤波和Heaviside投影来控制特征尺寸和制造公差。在两个甲板系列中，所有八个优化布局相对于尺寸优化参考方案均降低了AIP，且在经过有限深度拉伸后，还实现了更低的静柔度。对于无约束、制造感知和应力感知的框架变体，KATO在AIP方面与GCMMA方法相差在0.5 dB以内，同时在等体积二值化重分析后，静柔度降低了22-36倍。
tldr: 本研究将基于卷积Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KATO）的神经网络重参数化拓扑优化扩展到以主动输入功率为目标的船舶结构受迫振动设计，在发动机支撑甲板和推进器基座框架案例中，于AIP与GCMMA相当（差距0.5 dB内）的情况下将静柔度降低22-36倍，有效避免了共振附近的病态设计。
en_tdlr: This study extends neural-reparameterized topology optimization using a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KATO) to forced-vibration design of ship structures with active input power as the objective, achieving 22-36x lower static compliance than GCMMA at comparable AIP while avoiding pathological near-resonance designs.
